prices_title: How much a staircase costs and what shapes the budget
price_classic_note: Catalog-based monolithic staircases: clear geometry, predictable timeline, and transparent budgeting without extra complexity.
price_signature_note: Custom premium projects: complex architecture, non-standard engineering nodes, advanced visuals (renders/plans), and tailored development for your site.
calculator_note: This calculator estimates only the Classic format based on selected configuration.
calculator_signature_hint: For Signature, leave a request with a short project description — we will prepare an estimate as quickly as possible:
calc_stair_desc_l_winder: Turn is formed by winder steps.
calc_stair_desc_spiral: Spiral layout around the central axis.
calc_type_desc_smooth: Flat soffit without step profile repetition.
calc_type_desc_mirrored: Bottom profile repeats the top step pattern.
calc_type_desc_floating: Lighter visual with stringer/hidden support nodes.
calc_result_empty: Choose stair type, execution type, and enter height to see the estimate.
calc_result_too_low: Minimum stair height is above 20 cm.
calc_result_note: Final price depends on opening geometry, slab thickness, reinforcement, site conditions, and finishing requirements.
prices_footnote: Height-based rates: smooth bottom — 9.20 BYN/cm, mirrored step — 10.20 BYN/cm, floating step — 12.20 BYN/cm.
